paragraphs.text: But him that is weak in faith receive ye, [yet] not for decision of scruples.
paragraphs.original: Τὸν δὲ ἀσθενοῦντα τῇ πίστει προσλαμβάνεσθε, μὴ εἰς διακρίσεις διαλογισμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Ton de asthenounta tē pistei proslambanesthe, mē eis diakriseis dialogismōn.

paragraphs.text: One man hath faith to eat all things: but he that is weak eateth herbs.
paragraphs.original: ὃς μὲν πιστεύει φαγεῖν πάντα, ὁ δὲ ἀσθενῶν λάχανα ἐσθίει.
paragraphs.translit: hos men pisteuei phagein panta, ho de asthenōn lachana esthiei.

paragraphs.text: Let not him that eateth set at nought him that eateth not; and let not him that eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ἐσθίων τὸν μὴ ἐσθίοντα μὴ ἐξουθενείτω, ὁ δὲ μὴ ἐσθίων τὸν ἐσθίοντα μὴ κρινέτω, ὁ θεὸς γὰρ αὐτὸν προσελάβετο.
paragraphs.translit: ho esthiōn ton mē esthionta mē exoutheneitō, ho de mē esthiōn ton esthionta mē krinetō, ho theos gar auton proselabeto.

paragraphs.text: Who art thou that judgest the servant of another? to his own lord he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be made to stand; for the Lord hath power to make him stand.
paragraphs.original: σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ κρίνων ἀλλότριον οἰκέτην; τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ στήκει ἢ πίπτει· σταθήσεται δέ, δυνατεῖ γὰρ ὁ κύριος στῆσαι αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: sy tis ei ho krinōn allotrion oiketēn; tō idiō kyriō stēkei ē piptei· stathēsetai de, dynatei gar ho kyrios stēsai auton.

paragraphs.text: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
paragraphs.original: Ὃς μὲν κρίνει ἡμέραν παρʼ ἡμέραν, ὃς δὲ κρίνει πᾶσαν ἡμέραν· ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ νοῒ πληροφορείσθω·
paragraphs.translit: Hos men krinei hēmeran parʼ hēmeran, hos de krinei pasan hēmeran· hekastos en tō idiō noi plērophoreisthō·

paragraphs.text: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord: and he that eateth, eateth unto the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, unto the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
paragraphs.original: ὁ φρονῶν τὴν ἡμέραν κυρίῳ φρονεῖ. καὶ ὁ ἐσθίων κυρίῳ ἐσθίει, εὐχαριστεῖ γὰρ τῷ θεῷ· καὶ ὁ μὴ ἐσθίων κυρίῳ οὐκ ἐσθίει, καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ θεῷ.
paragraphs.translit: ho phronōn tēn hēmeran kyriō phronei. kai ho esthiōn kyriō esthiei, eucharistei gar tō theō· kai ho mē esthiōn kyriō ouk esthiei, kai eucharistei tō theō.

paragraphs.text: For none of us liveth to himself, and none dieth to himself.
paragraphs.original: Οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἑαυτῷ ζῇ, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἑαυτῷ ἀποθνῄσκει·
paragraphs.translit: Oudeis gar hēmōn heautō zē, kai oudeis heautō apothnēskei·

paragraphs.text: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; or whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord`s.
paragraphs.original: ἐάν τε γὰρ ζῶμεν, τῷ κυρίῳ ζῶμεν, ἐάν τε ἀποθνῄσκωμεν, τῷ κυρίῳ ἀποθνῄσκομεν. ἐάν τε οὖν ζῶμεν ἐάν τε ἀποθνῄσκωμεν, τοῦ κυρίου ἐσμέν.
paragraphs.translit: ean te gar zōmen, tō kyriō zōmen, ean te apothnēskōmen, tō kyriō apothnēskomen. ean te oun zōmen ean te apothnēskōmen, tou kyriou esmen.

paragraphs.text: For to this end Christ died and lived [again], that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
paragraphs.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἔζησεν ἵνα καὶ νεκρῶν καὶ ζώντων κυριεύσῃ.
paragraphs.translit: eis touto gar Christos apethanen kai ezēsen hina kai nekrōn kai zōntōn kyrieusē.

paragraphs.text: But thou, why dost thou judge thy brother? or thou again, why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment-seat of God.
paragraphs.original: Σὺ δὲ τί κρίνεις τὸν ἀδελφόν σου; ἢ καὶ σὺ τί ἐξουθενεῖς τὸν ἀδελφόν σου; πάντες γὰρ παραστησόμεθα τῷ βήματι τοῦ θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Sy de ti krineis ton adelphon sou; ē kai sy ti exoutheneis ton adelphon sou; pantes gar parastēsometha tō bēmati tou theou,

paragraphs.text: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, to me every knee shall bow, And every tongue shall confess to God.
paragraphs.original: γέγραπται γάρ· Ζῶ ἐγώ, λέγει κύριος, ὅτι ἐμοὶ κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ, καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσεται τῷ θεῷ.
paragraphs.translit: gegraptai gar· Zō egō, legei kyrios, hoti emoi kampsei pan gony, kai pasa glōssa exomologēsetai tō theō.

paragraphs.text: So then each one of us shall give account of himself to God.
paragraphs.original: ἄρα ἕκαστος ἡμῶν περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λόγον δώσει.
paragraphs.translit: ara hekastos hēmōn peri heautou logon dōsei.

paragraphs.text: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge ye this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock in his brother`s way, or an occasion of falling.
paragraphs.original: Μηκέτι οὖν ἀλλήλους κρίνωμεν· ἀλλὰ τοῦτο κρίνατε μᾶλλον, τὸ μὴ τιθέναι πρόσκομμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ ἢ σκάνδαλον.
paragraphs.translit: Mēketi oun allēlous krinōmen· alla touto krinate mallon, to mē tithenai proskomma tō adelphō ē skandalon.

paragraphs.text: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself: save that to him who accounteth anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
paragraphs.original: οἶδα καὶ πέπεισμαι ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι οὐδὲν κοινὸν διʼ ἑαυτοῦ· εἰ μὴ τῷ λογιζομένῳ τι κοινὸν εἶναι, ἐκείνῳ κοινόν.
paragraphs.translit: oida kai pepeismai en kyriō Iēsou hoti ouden koinon diʼ heautou· ei mē tō logizomenō ti koinon einai, ekeinō koinon.

paragraphs.text: For if because of meat thy brother is grieved, thou walkest no longer in love. Destroy not with thy meat him for whom Christ died.
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ διὰ βρῶμα ὁ ἀδελφός σου λυπεῖται, οὐκέτι κατὰ ἀγάπην περιπατεῖς. μὴ τῷ βρώματί σου ἐκεῖνον ἀπόλλυε ὑπὲρ οὗ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν.
paragraphs.translit: ei gar dia brōma ho adelphos sou lypeitai, ouketi kata agapēn peripateis. mē tō brōmati sou ekeinon apollye hyper hou Christos apethanen.

paragraphs.text: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
paragraphs.original: μὴ βλασφημείσθω οὖν ὑμῶν τὸ ἀγαθόν.
paragraphs.translit: mē blasphēmeisthō oun hymōn to agathon.

paragraphs.text: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ βρῶσις καὶ πόσις, ἀλλὰ δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ χαρὰ ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ·
paragraphs.translit: ou gar estin hē basileia tou theou brōsis kai posis, alla dikaiosynē kai eirēnē kai chara en pneumati hagiō·

paragraphs.text: For he that herein serveth Christ is well-pleasing to God, and approved of men.
paragraphs.original: ὁ γὰρ ἐν τούτῳ δουλεύων τῷ Χριστῷ εὐάρεστος τῷ θεῷ καὶ δόκιμος τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.
paragraphs.translit: ho gar en toutō douleuōn tō Christō euarestos tō theō kai dokimos tois anthrōpois.

paragraphs.text: So then let us follow after things which make for peace, and things whereby we may edify one another.
paragraphs.original: ἄρα οὖν τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης διώκωμεν καὶ τὰ τῆς οἰκοδομῆς τῆς εἰς ἀλλήλους.
paragraphs.translit: ara oun ta tēs eirēnēs diōkōmen kai ta tēs oikodomēs tēs eis allēlous.

paragraphs.text: Overthrow not for meat`s sake the work of God. All things indeed are clean; howbeit it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
paragraphs.original: μὴ ἕνεκεν βρώματος κατάλυε τὸ ἔργον τοῦ θεοῦ. πάντα μὲν καθαρά, ἀλλὰ κακὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ διὰ προσκόμματος ἐσθίοντι.
paragraphs.translit: mē heneken brōmatos katalye to ergon tou theou. panta men kathara, alla kakon tō anthrōpō tō dia proskommatos esthionti.

paragraphs.text: It is good not to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor [to do anything] whereby thy brother stumbleth.
paragraphs.original: καλὸν τὸ μὴ φαγεῖν κρέα μηδὲ πιεῖν οἶνον μηδὲ ἐν ᾧ ὁ ἀδελφός σου προσκόπτει ἢ σκανδαλίζεται ἢ ἀσθενεῖ·
paragraphs.translit: kalon to mē phagein krea mēde piein oinon mēde en hō ho adelphos sou proskoptei ē skandalizetai ē asthenei·

paragraphs.text: The faith which thou hast, have thou to thyself before God. Happy is he that judgeth not himself in that which he approveth.
paragraphs.original: σὺ πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις κατὰ σεαυτὸν ἔχε ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ. μακάριος ὁ μὴ κρίνων ἑαυτὸν ἐν ᾧ δοκιμάζει·
paragraphs.translit: sy pistin hēn echeis kata seauton eche enōpion tou theou. makarios ho mē krinōn heauton en hō dokimazei·

paragraphs.text: But he that doubteth is condemned if he eat, because [he eateth] not of faith; and whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ διακρινόμενος ἐὰν φάγῃ κατακέκριται, ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως· πᾶν δὲ ὃ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἁμαρτία ἐστίν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de diakrinomenos ean phagē katakekritai, hoti ouk ek pisteōs· pan de ho ouk ek pisteōs hamartia estin.
